statement: Publish a Grasshopper definition to the cloud so its parameters and outputs become a web-accessible parametric model.

acceptance.tolerance: All displayed at the right anchors within 0.1 mm

statement: Define downloadable file exports from a model with chosen format, file name and optional JSON of parameter values.
